title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.28380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. translated_title: 面向对象执行框架：通过面向对象设计演化智能体执行框架
translated_abstract: 智能体执行框架是围绕语言模型指定提示词、工具和控制流的可执行代码。单一的全局框架在处理需要不同执行策略的异构任务时可能表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了面向对象执行框架（OO-Harness），这是一个利用面向对象设计演化出可执行框架类层次的框架优化方法。在训练过程中，一个演化智能体利用执行记录创建一系列专门化的框架，每个框架都通过继承实现为基类或现有专门化框架的子类。在测试时，一个框架路由器利用训练期间积累的路由经验为每个任务选择特定的框架。在涵盖业务工作流、工作区任务和工具使用的三个长程基准测试中，OO-Harness在对比方法中取得了最佳性能，相比基线实现了最高达15%的绝对提升。
tldr: 提出OO-Harness框架，利用面向对象设计中的继承机制演化出专门化执行框架的类层次结构，并通过路由器为不同任务选择最优框架，在三个长程基准测试中相比基线最高提升15%。
en_tdlr: Proposes OO-Harness, a framework that evolves a hierarchy of specialized agent harnesses through object-oriented inheritance and uses a router to select the best harness for each task, achieving up to 15% absolute improvement over the base across three long-horizon benchmarks.
